```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Ten plik zawiera brakujące aktualizacje kodu wskazane przy porównaniu projektu
# z notatnikami. Drzewa decyzyjne celowo nie są tutaj zmieniane.

packages <- c(
  "dplyr", "lubridate", "leaps", "glmnet", "mgcv", "lme4", "pROC"
)
missing_packages <- packages[!vapply(packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Brakuje pakietów: ", paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
    "\nZainstaluj je np. install.packages(c(",
    paste(sprintf('"%s"', missing_packages), collapse = ", "), "))"
  )
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(lubridate)
  library(leaps)
  library(glmnet)
  library(mgcv)
  library(lme4)
  library(pROC)
})

# Jeżeli w Twoim projekcie ramka danych ma inną nazwę, ustaw ją tutaj ręcznie,
# np. weather_df <- meteo albo weather_df <- dane.
if (!exists("weather_df")) {
  candidate_names <- c("dane", "df", "weather", "weather_data", "meteo", "meteo_df", "data_meteo")
  found <- candidate_names[vapply(candidate_names, exists, logical(1))]
  if (length(found) == 0) {
    stop("Nie znaleziono ramki danych. Utwórz obiekt weather_df albo zmień listę candidate_names.")
  }
  weather_df <- get(found[1])
}
```

## Funkcje wspólne

```{r funkcje-wspolne}
normalize_openmeteo_names <- function(df) {
  # Opcjonalna normalizacja nazw z surowego CSV Open-Meteo, np.
  # "wind_speed_10m (km/h)" -> "wind_speed_10m".
  new_names <- names(df)
  new_names <- gsub("\\s*\\(.*?\\)", "", new_names)
  new_names <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_", new_names)
  new_names <- gsub("_+$", "", new_names)
  new_names <- tolower(new_names)
  names(df) <- new_names
  df
}

find_first_existing_name <- function(df, candidates) {
  original_names <- names(df)
  normalized_names <- tolower(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_", original_names))
  candidates_norm <- tolower(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_", candidates))

  hit <- match(candidates_norm, normalized_names)
  hit <- hit[!is.na(hit)]
  if (length(hit) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  original_names[hit[1]]
}

build_datetime_column <- function(df) {
  # Najczęstszy wariant w danych z Open-Meteo to kolumna "time".
  datetime_col <- find_first_existing_name(
    df,
    c("datetime", "date_time", "timestamp", "time", "czas", "data_czas")
  )

  if (!is.na(datetime_col)) {
    df$datetime <- as.POSIXct(df[[datetime_col]], tz = "UTC")
    return(df)
  }

  # Wariant awaryjny: osobne kolumny daty i godziny.
  date_col <- find_first_existing_name(df, c("date", "data", "day"))
  hour_col <- find_first_existing_name(df, c("hour", "godzina", "time_hour"))

  if (!is.na(date_col) && !is.na(hour_col)) {
    hour_value <- df[[hour_col]]
    if (is.numeric(hour_value)) {
      hour_value <- sprintf("%02d:00:00", as.integer(hour_value))
    }
    df$datetime <- as.POSIXct(paste(df[[date_col]], hour_value), tz = "UTC")
    return(df)
  }

  # Ostateczny wariant: sama data. Godzina zostanie wtedy ustawiona na 00:00,
  # więc dla danych godzinowych lepiej mieć jednak kolumnę time albo date + hour.
  if (!is.na(date_col)) {
    warning("Znaleziono tylko kolumnę daty bez godziny. Godzina zostanie ustawiona na 00:00.")
    df$datetime <- as.POSIXct(df[[date_col]], tz = "UTC")
    return(df)
  }

  stop(
    "Nie znaleziono kolumny czasu. Kod szuka jednej z kolumn: datetime, date_time, timestamp, time, czas, data_czas albo pary date/data + hour/godzina.\n",
    "Obecne kolumny w danych to: ", paste(names(df), collapse = ", "), "\n",
    "Najprostsza poprawka: przed uruchomieniem kodu wykonaj np. weather_df <- weather_df |> rename(datetime = time), jeżeli kolumna czasu nazywa się time."
  )
}

prepare_weather_project <- function(df, cutoff = "2025-01-01") {
  df <- normalize_openmeteo_names(df)
  df <- build_datetime_column(df)

  if (any(is.na(df$datetime))) {
    stop(
      "Kolumna czasu została znaleziona, ale część wartości nie dała się zamienić na POSIXct. ",
      "Sprawdź format daty/czasu w kolumnie czasu."
    )
  }

  df <- df |>
    mutate(
      datetime = as.POSIXct(datetime, tz = "UTC"),
      date = as.Date(datetime),
      rok = lubridate::year(datetime),
      miesiac = factor(lubridate::month(datetime)),
      dzien_roku = lubridate::yday(datetime),
      godzina = lubridate::hour(datetime),
      sin_dzien = sin(2 * pi * dzien_roku / 365),
      cos_dzien = cos(2 * pi * dzien_roku / 365),
      sin_godzina = sin(2 * pi * godzina / 24),
      cos_godzina = cos(2 * pi * godzina / 24),
      sezon = factor(ifelse(lubridate::month(datetime) %in% 4:9, "cieply", "chlodny"))
    ) |>
    arrange(datetime)

  if ("wind_direction_10m" %in% names(df)) {
    df <- df |>
      mutate(
        wind_dir_sin = sin(2 * pi * wind_direction_10m / 360),
        wind_dir_cos = cos(2 * pi * wind_direction_10m / 360)
      )
  }

  if ("wind_speed_10m" %in% names(df) && !"wind_speed_10m_next" %in% names(df)) {
    df <- df |> mutate(wind_speed_10m_next = lead(wind_speed_10m))
  }
  if ("wind_gusts_10m" %in% names(df) && !"wind_gusts_10m_next" %in% names(df)) {
    df <- df |> mutate(wind_gusts_10m_next = lead(wind_gusts_10m))
  }
  if ("is_day" %in% names(df) && !"is_day_next" %in% names(df)) {
    df <- df |> mutate(is_day_next = lead(is_day))
  }

  df <- df |>
    mutate(train_set = datetime < as.POSIXct(cutoff, tz = "UTC"))

  df
}

available_predictors <- function(df, extra = character()) {
  base <- c(
    "wind_speed_10m", "wind_speed_100m", "wind_gusts_10m",
    "wind_dir_sin", "wind_dir_cos",
    "temperature_2m", "relative_humidity_2m", "dew_point_2m",
    "apparent_temperature", "precipitation", "cloud_cover",
    "pressure_msl", "surface_pressure", "shortwave_radiation",
    "sin_dzien", "cos_dzien", "sin_godzina", "cos_godzina",
    "miesiac", "sezon"
  )
  intersect(c(base, extra), names(df))
}

align_model_matrix <- function(train_df, test_df, predictors) {
  x_train <- model.matrix(reformulate(predictors), data = train_df)[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  x_test <- model.matrix(reformulate(predictors), data = test_df)[, -1, drop = FALSE]

  missing_cols <- setdiff(colnames(x_train), colnames(x_test))
  for (cl in missing_cols) x_test <- cbind(x_test, setNames(data.frame(0), cl))

  extra_cols <- setdiff(colnames(x_test), colnames(x_train))
  if (length(extra_cols) > 0) x_test <- x_test[, setdiff(colnames(x_test), extra_cols), drop = FALSE]

  x_test <- x_test[, colnames(x_train), drop = FALSE]
  list(x_train = x_train, x_test = x_test)
}

regression_metrics <- function(y, pred) {
  mse <- mean((y - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  rmse <- sqrt(mse)
  mae <- mean(abs(y - pred), na.rm = TRUE)
  r2 <- 1 - sum((y - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE) / sum((y - mean(y, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  data.frame(MSE = mse, RMSE = rmse, MAE = mae, R2 = r2)
}

classification_metrics <- function(y, prob, threshold = 0.5) {
  y <- as.integer(y)
  pred <- as.integer(prob >= threshold)
  tp <- sum(pred == 1 & y == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  tn <- sum(pred == 0 & y == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  fp <- sum(pred == 1 & y == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  fn <- sum(pred == 0 & y == 1, na.rm = TRUE)

  accuracy <- (tp + tn) / (tp + tn + fp + fn)
  sensitivity <- ifelse(tp + fn == 0, NA, tp / (tp + fn))
  specificity <- ifelse(tn + fp == 0, NA, tn / (tn + fp))
  precision <- ifelse(tp + fp == 0, NA, tp / (tp + fp))
  f1 <- ifelse(is.na(precision) || is.na(sensitivity) || precision + sensitivity == 0,
               NA, 2 * precision * sensitivity / (precision + sensitivity))
  auc <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(pROC::roc(y, prob, quiet = TRUE)))

  data.frame(
    threshold = threshold,
    AUC = auc,
    accuracy = accuracy,
    sensitivity = sensitivity,
    specificity = specificity,
    precision = precision,
    F1 = f1
  )
}

best_f1_threshold <- function(y, prob, grid = seq(0.05, 0.95, by = 0.01)) {
  metrics <- lapply(grid, function(th) classification_metrics(y, prob, th)) |> bind_rows()
  metrics$threshold[which.max(metrics$F1)]
}

weather_df <- prepare_weather_project(weather_df)
```

## 1. Selekcja krokowa forward i backward

```{r selekcja-forward-backward}
run_stepwise_selection <- function(df, target, predictors = available_predictors(df), cutoff = "2025-01-01") {
  model_df <- df |>
    filter(!is.na(.data[[target]])) |>
    select(all_of(c("train_set", target, predictors))) |>
    na.omit()

  train_df <- model_df |> filter(train_set) |> select(-train_set)
  test_df <- model_df |> filter(!train_set) |> select(-train_set)

  full_formula <- reformulate(predictors, response = target)
  null_formula <- as.formula(paste(target, "~ 1"))

  full_lm <- lm(full_formula, data = train_df)
  null_lm <- lm(null_formula, data = train_df)

  # Kryterium BIC w funkcji step(): k = log(n)
  k_bic <- log(nrow(train_df))

  step_forward_bic <- step(
    null_lm,
    scope = list(lower = null_formula, upper = full_formula),
    direction = "forward",
    trace = 0,
    k = k_bic
  )

  step_backward_bic <- step(
    full_lm,
    direction = "backward",
    trace = 0,
    k = k_bic
  )

  pred_forward <- predict(step_forward_bic, newdata = test_df)
  pred_backward <- predict(step_backward_bic, newdata = test_df)

  bind_rows(
    cbind(model = "step forward BIC", regression_metrics(test_df[[target]], pred_forward)),
    cbind(model = "step backward BIC", regression_metrics(test_df[[target]], pred_backward))
  )
}

run_regsubsets_methods <- function(df, target, predictors = available_predictors(df), nvmax = NULL) {
  model_df <- df |>
    filter(!is.na(.data[[target]])) |>
    select(all_of(c("train_set", target, predictors))) |>
    na.omit()

  train_df <- model_df |> filter(train_set) |> select(-train_set)
  test_df <- model_df |> filter(!train_set) |> select(-train_set)

  if (is.null(nvmax)) nvmax <- min(length(predictors), 25)

  evaluate_regsubsets <- function(method) {
    fit <- leaps::regsubsets(
      reformulate(predictors, response = target),
      data = train_df,
      nvmax = nvmax,
      method = method
    )
    s <- summary(fit)

    chosen <- c(
      BIC = which.min(s$bic),
      Cp = which.min(s$cp),
      AdjR2 = which.max(s$adjr2)
    )

    bind_rows(lapply(names(chosen), function(criterion) {
      id <- chosen[[criterion]]
      vars <- names(which(s$which[id, ]))
      vars <- setdiff(vars, "(Intercept)")
      lm_fit <- lm(reformulate(vars, response = target), data = train_df)
      pred <- predict(lm_fit, newdata = test_df)
      cbind(
        method = method,
        criterion = criterion,
        n_predictors = length(vars),
        predictors = paste(vars, collapse = ", "),
        regression_metrics(test_df[[target]], pred)
      )
    }))
  }

  bind_rows(
    evaluate_regsubsets("exhaustive"),
    evaluate_regsubsets("forward"),
    evaluate_regsubsets("backward")
  )
}

# Przykład użycia dla obu zmiennych zależnych:
predictors_reg <- available_predictors(weather_df)

stepwise_speed <- run_stepwise_selection(weather_df, "wind_speed_10m_next", predictors_reg)
stepwise_gusts <- run_stepwise_selection(weather_df, "wind_gusts_10m_next", predictors_reg)

regsubsets_speed <- run_regsubsets_methods(weather_df, "wind_speed_10m_next", predictors_reg)
regsubsets_gusts <- run_regsubsets_methods(weather_df, "wind_gusts_10m_next", predictors_reg)

stepwise_speed
stepwise_gusts
regsubsets_speed
regsubsets_gusts
```

## 2. glmnet: ridge/lasso oraz regularyzowany Poisson

```{r glmnet-ridge-lasso}
run_glmnet_regression <- function(df, target, predictors = available_predictors(df), alpha_value = 1) {
  model_df <- df |>
    filter(!is.na(.data[[target]])) |>
    select(all_of(c("train_set", target, predictors))) |>
    na.omit()

  train_df <- model_df |> filter(train_set) |> select(-train_set)
  test_df <- model_df |> filter(!train_set) |> select(-train_set)

  mm <- align_model_matrix(train_df, test_df, predictors)
  y_train <- train_df[[target]]
  y_test <- test_df[[target]]

  cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(
    x = mm$x_train,
    y = y_train,
    alpha = alpha_value,
    family = "gaussian",
    nfolds = 10
  )

  pred_min <- as.numeric(predict(cv_fit, newx = mm$x_test, s = "lambda.min"))
  pred_1se <- as.numeric(predict(cv_fit, newx = mm$x_test, s = "lambda.1se"))

  out <- bind_rows(
    cbind(lambda = "lambda.min", regression_metrics(y_test, pred_min)),
    cbind(lambda = "lambda.1se", regression_metrics(y_test, pred_1se))
  )

  list(cv_fit = cv_fit, results = out)
}

ridge_speed <- run_glmnet_regression(weather_df, "wind_speed_10m_next", predictors_reg, alpha_value = 0)
lasso_speed <- run_glmnet_regression(weather_df, "wind_speed_10m_next", predictors_reg, alpha_value = 1)
ridge_gusts <- run_glmnet_regression(weather_df, "wind_gusts_10m_next", predictors_reg, alpha_value = 0)
lasso_gusts <- run_glmnet_regression(weather_df, "wind_gusts_10m_next", predictors_reg, alpha_value = 1)

ridge_speed$results
lasso_speed$results
ridge_gusts$results
lasso_gusts$results
```

```{r poisson-lasso}
make_good_hours_daily <- function(df,
                                  wind_min = 12,
                                  wind_max = 40,
                                  gust_max = 55,
                                  use_daylight = TRUE,
                                  predictors = available_predictors(df)) {
  stopifnot(all(c("date", "wind_speed_10m_next", "wind_gusts_10m_next") %in% names(df)))

  df <- df |>
    mutate(
      good_hour_next = wind_speed_10m_next >= wind_min &
        wind_speed_10m_next <= wind_max &
        wind_gusts_10m_next <= gust_max
    )

  if (use_daylight && "is_day_next" %in% names(df)) {
    df <- df |> mutate(good_hour_next = good_hour_next & is_day_next == 1)
  }

  num_predictors <- predictors[vapply(df[predictors], is.numeric, logical(1))]
  num_predictors <- setdiff(num_predictors, c("rok", "dzien_roku", "godzina"))

  df |>
    filter(!is.na(good_hour_next)) |>
    group_by(date) |>
    summarise(
      good_hours = sum(good_hour_next, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_hours = n(),
      datetime = min(datetime),
      train_set = first(train_set),
      rok = first(rok),
      miesiac = first(miesiac),
      dzien_roku = first(dzien_roku),
      across(all_of(num_predictors), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    filter(n_hours > 0)
}

poisson_deviance <- function(y, mu) {
  mu <- pmax(mu, .Machine$double.eps)
  term <- ifelse(y == 0, 0, y * log(y / mu))
  2 * sum(term - (y - mu), na.rm = TRUE)
}

run_poisson_lasso <- function(daily_df, predictors = available_predictors(daily_df)) {
  predictors <- predictors[vapply(daily_df[predictors], is.numeric, logical(1))]
  predictors <- setdiff(predictors, c("rok", "dzien_roku", "godzina"))

  model_df <- daily_df |>
    select(all_of(c("train_set", "good_hours", predictors))) |>
    na.omit()

  train_df <- model_df |> filter(train_set) |> select(-train_set)
  test_df <- model_df |> filter(!train_set) |> select(-train_set)

  mm <- align_model_matrix(train_df, test_df, predictors)
  y_train <- train_df$good_hours
  y_test <- test_df$good_hours

  cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(
    x = mm$x_train,
    y = y_train,
    family = "poisson",
    alpha = 1,
    nfolds = 10
  )

  pred_min <- as.numeric(predict(cv_fit, newx = mm$x_test, s = "lambda.min", type = "response"))
  pred_1se <- as.numeric(predict(cv_fit, newx = mm$x_test, s = "lambda.1se", type = "response"))

  bind_rows(
    cbind(
      model = "Poisson lasso lambda.min",
      regression_metrics(y_test, pred_min),
      deviance = poisson_deviance(y_test, pred_min)
    ),
    cbind(
      model = "Poisson lasso lambda.1se",
      regression_metrics(y_test, pred_1se),
      deviance = poisson_deviance(y_test, pred_1se)
    )
  )
}

daily_good_hours <- make_good_hours_daily(weather_df, predictors = predictors_reg)
poisson_lasso_results <- run_poisson_lasso(daily_good_hours)
poisson_lasso_results
```

## 3. Modele nieliniowe: klasyfikacja logistyczna z wielomianami i GAM

```{r nieliniowa-klasyfikacja}
add_event_variables <- function(df, speed_threshold_kt = 15, gust_threshold_kt = 25) {
  kt_to_kmh <- 1.852
  df |>
    mutate(
      wind_speed_10m_next_event = as.integer(wind_speed_10m_next >= speed_threshold_kt * kt_to_kmh),
      wind_gusts_10m_next_event = as.integer(wind_gusts_10m_next >= gust_threshold_kt * kt_to_kmh)
    )
}

run_logistic_poly <- function(df,
                              target_event,
                              main_predictor,
                              other_predictors,
                              degrees = 2:5) {
  model_df <- df |>
    filter(!is.na(.data[[target_event]]), !is.na(.data[[main_predictor]])) |>
    select(all_of(c("train_set", target_event, main_predictor, other_predictors))) |>
    na.omit()

  train_df <- model_df |> filter(train_set) |> select(-train_set)
  test_df <- model_df |> filter(!train_set) |> select(-train_set)

  bind_rows(lapply(degrees, function(d) {
    rhs <- c(sprintf("poly(%s, %s)", main_predictor, d), other_predictors)
    form <- as.formula(paste(target_event, "~", paste(rhs, collapse = " + ")))
    fit <- glm(form, data = train_df, family = binomial)

    prob_train <- predict(fit, newdata = train_df, type = "response")
    threshold <- best_f1_threshold(train_df[[target_event]], prob_train)
    prob_test <- predict(fit, newdata = test_df, type = "response")

    cbind(
      model = paste0("logistic polynomial degree ", d),
      main_predictor = main_predictor,
      classification_metrics(test_df[[target_event]], prob_test, threshold)
    )
  }))
}

run_logistic_gam <- function(df,
                             target_event,
                             smooth_predictors,
                             linear_predictors,
                             k = 6) {
  predictors <- unique(c(smooth_predictors, linear_predictors))

  model_df <- df |>
    filter(!is.na(.data[[target_event]])) |>
    select(all_of(c("train_set", target_event, predictors))) |>
    na.omit()

  train_df <- model_df |> filter(train_set) |> select(-train_set)
  test_df <- model_df |> filter(!train_set) |> select(-train_set)

  smooth_terms <- sprintf("s(%s, k = %s)", smooth_predictors, k)
  rhs <- c(smooth_terms, linear_predictors)
  form <- as.formula(paste(target_event, "~", paste(rhs, collapse = " + ")))

  fit <- mgcv::gam(form, data = train_df, family = binomial, method = "REML")

  prob_train <- predict(fit, newdata = train_df, type = "response")
  threshold <- best_f1_threshold(train_df[[target_event]], prob_train)
  prob_test <- predict(fit, newdata = test_df, type = "response")

  list(
    fit = fit,
    results = cbind(
      model = "logistic GAM",
      classification_metrics(test_df[[target_event]], prob_test, threshold)
    )
  )
}

weather_df <- add_event_variables(weather_df)

class_predictors <- setdiff(
```

## 4. LMM: ICC i składowe wariancji

```{r lmm-icc}
icc_lmm <- function(model) {
  vc <- as.data.frame(lme4::VarCorr(model))
  var_rows <- vc |> filter(is.na(var2))

  residual_var <- attr(lme4::VarCorr(model), "sc")^2
  random_total <- sum(var_rows$vcov, na.rm = TRUE)
  total_var <- random_total + residual_var

  by_component <- var_rows |>
    transmute(
      group = grp,
      term = var1,
      variance = vcov,
      ICC_component = vcov / total_var
    )

  by_group <- by_component |>
    group_by(group) |>
    summarise(
      variance = sum(variance, na.rm = TRUE),
      ICC_group = variance / total_var,
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  list(
    residual_variance = residual_var,
    random_total = random_total,
    total_variance = total_var,
    by_component = by_component,
    by_group = by_group
  )
}

# Przykład użycia po dopasowaniu modelu LMM:
# icc_lmm(lmm_speed_best)$by_group
# icc_lmm(lmm_gusts_best)$by_group

# Jeżeli w środowisku istnieją obiekty modeli LMM, poniższy kod policzy ICC automatycznie.
lmm_objects <- ls(pattern = "lmm|LMM")
lmm_objects <- lmm_objects[vapply(lmm_objects, function(x) inherits(get(x), "merMod"), logical(1))]

icc_results <- lapply(lmm_objects, function(obj_name) {
  out <- icc_lmm(get(obj_name))$by_group
  out$model <- obj_name
  out
})

if (length(icc_results) > 0) {
  bind_rows(icc_results) |> select(model, everything())
}
```

## 5. GLMM: zagregowana odpowiedź dwumianowa

```{r glmm-zagregowany-binomial}
make_aggregated_binomial <- function(df,
                                     target_event,
                                     predictors,
                                     group_vars = c("rok", "miesiac", "dzien_roku")) {
  group_vars <- intersect(group_vars, names(df))
  predictors <- predictors[vapply(df[predictors], is.numeric, logical(1))]
  predictors <- setdiff(predictors, c("rok", "dzien_roku", "godzina"))

  df |>
    filter(!is.na(.data[[target_event]])) |>
    group_by(across(all_of(group_vars))) |>
    summarise(
      sukcesy = sum(.data[[target_event]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      porazki = sum(.data[[target_event]] == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = sukcesy + porazki,
      datetime = min(datetime),
      train_set = first(train_set),
      across(all_of(predictors), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    filter(n > 0)
}

fit_aggregated_glmm <- function(agg_df, predictors, random_structure = "(1 | miesiac) + (1 | miesiac:dzien_roku)") {
  predictors <- predictors[vapply(agg_df[predictors], is.numeric, logical(1))]
  predictors <- setdiff(predictors, c("rok", "dzien_roku", "godzina"))

  train_df <- agg_df |> filter(train_set) |> na.omit()
  test_df <- agg_df |> filter(!train_set) |> na.omit()

  rhs <- paste(c(predictors, random_structure), collapse = " + ")
  form <- as.formula(paste("cbind(sukcesy, porazki) ~", rhs))

  fit <- lme4::glmer(
    form,
    data = train_df,
    family = binomial,
    control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5))
  )

  prob_test <- predict(fit, newdata = test_df, type = "response", allow.new.levels = TRUE)
  y_test <- test_df$sukcesy / test_df$n

  list(
    fit = fit,
    test_comparison = test_df |>
      mutate(
        prop_mle = sukcesy / n,
        prop_glmm = prob_test,
        abs_error = abs(prop_mle - prop_glmm)
      ),
    summary_metrics = data.frame(
      mean_abs_error_prop = mean(abs(y_test - prob_test), na.rm = TRUE),
      brier_grouped = mean((y_test - prob_test)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )
}

agg_speed <- make_aggregated_binomial(
  weather_df,
  target_event = "wind_speed_10m_next_event",
  predictors = predictors_reg
)

agg_gusts <- make_aggregated_binomial(
  weather_df,
  target_event = "wind_gusts_10m_next_event",
  predictors = predictors_reg
)

agg_glmm_speed <- fit_aggregated_glmm(agg_speed, predictors_reg)
agg_glmm_gusts <- fit_aggregated_glmm(agg_gusts, predictors_reg)

agg_glmm_speed$summary_metrics
agg_glmm_gusts$summary_metrics

# Porównanie surowych estymat MLE z estymatami GLMM dla kilku grup testowych:
agg_glmm_speed$test_comparison |>
  select(any_of(c("rok", "miesiac", "dzien_roku")), sukcesy, porazki, n, prop_mle, prop_glmm, abs_error) |>
  head(20)

agg_glmm_gusts$test_comparison |>
  select(any_of(c("rok", "miesiac", "dzien_roku")), sukcesy, porazki, n, prop_mle, prop_glmm, abs_error) |>
  head(20)
```
